source: Transliterated from the Urdu translation of Maulana Muhammad Junagarhi.

ayahs.1: Shuroo karta hoon Allah Taala ke naam se jo bada meharbaan nihaayat reham wala hai.
ayahs.2: Sab taareef Allah Taala ke liye hai jo tamaam jahanon ka paalne wala hai.
ayahs.3: Bada meharbaan nihaayat reham karne wala.
ayahs.4: Badle ke din (yaani qayamat) ka maalik hai.
ayahs.5: Hum sirf teri hi ibaadat karte hain aur sirf tujh hi se madad chaahte hain.
ayahs.7: Un logon ki raah jin par tu ne inaam kiya, un ki nahi jin par ghazab kiya gaya (yaani woh log jinhon ne haq ko pehchana, magar us par amal paira nahi hue) aur na gumraahon ki (yaani woh log jo jahalat ke sabab raah-e-haq se bargashta hogaye).
